metadata.question: Did the water extent of Lake Sambhar, India, decrease between 2018 and 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Lake Sambhar, India (approximately 26.9°N, 75.1°E) - Time periods: 2018 (full year) vs 2019 (full year) - Collection: JRC Global Surface Water or Sentinel-1 SAR (for water detection), or use Sentinel-2/Landsat with water indices (NDWI/MNDWI) - I'll use Sentinel-2 with MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) for water extent detection 2. Masking strategy: - Need to mask clouds heavily since we're looking at water extent - Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2 cloud masking - Calculate MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) - Threshold MNDWI > 0 to identify water pixels 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Lake could genuinely have less water (answer based on comparison) - C1: No images found for either year - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - Compare water pixel counts between 2018 and 2019 - If 2019 < 2018, answer A (Yes, decreased) - If 2019 >= 2018, answer B (No, did not decrease) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeSambhar = ee.Geometry.Point([75.1, 26.9]).buffer(15000); // 15km buffer around lake center const date2018Start = '2018-01-01'; const date2018End = '2018-12-31'; const date2019Start = '2019-01-01'; const date2019End = '2019-12-31'; // Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBit = 1 << 10; const cirrusBit = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBit).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Water detection function using MNDWI function addMNDWI(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check let col2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeSambhar) .filterDate(date2018Start, date2018End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addMNDWI); let col2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeSambhar) .filterDate(date2019Start, date2019End) .map(maskClouds) .map(addMNDWI); const size2018 = await col2018.size().getInfo(); const size2019 = await col2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Images: ${size2018}`); console.log(`2019 Images: ${size2019}`); if (size2018 === 0 || size2019 === 0) { console.log("Insufficient data for one or both years."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create median composites const composite2018 = col2018.median(); const composite2019 = col2019.median(); // Identify water pixels (MNDWI > 0) const water2018 = composite2018.select('MNDWI').gt(0); const water2019 = composite2019.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // 4. Calculate water extent (pixel count) const stats2018 = await water2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeSambhar, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2019 = await water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeSambhar, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const waterPixels2018 = stats2018.MNDWI; const waterPixels2019 = stats2019.MNDWI; console.log(`2018 Water Pixels: ${waterPixels2018}`); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${waterPixels2019}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (waterPixels2018 === null || waterPixels2019 === null || waterPixels2018 === undefined || waterPixels2019 === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed - null values."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (waterPixels2018 === 0 && waterPixels2019 === 0) { console.log("No valid water pixels detected in either year."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Compare water extent if (waterPixels2019 < waterPixels2018) { console.log("Water extent decreased from 2018 to 2019."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Water extent did not decrease from 2018 to 2019."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
